intent: Backfill Reordering & Windowing. With window from TelemetryProperties: accept(sample, nowEpochMs) returns the samples whose tDeviceEpochMs <= now - window, ordered ascending by tDeviceEpochMs (never t_ingress); a late sample arriving within the window is placed in correct chronological position; samples inside the window are retained; drain() returns all remaining sorted by t_device and empties the buffer.

methods.signature: public java.util.List<TelemetrySample> accept(TelemetrySample sample, long nowEpochMs)
